name: Beach & Resort
tagline: Linen, sunsets and seaside calm, tastefully dressed.
description: Vacation photos that are all about the place and the mood: shoreline walks, cabanas, boardwalks, seaside cafés, beach bonfires, hammocks, tide pools and overwater villas. Breezy linen shirts, sundresses and resort wear only, perfect to share with family and colleagues alike.
